title: Fix Surface Map showing empty canvas after completed discovery run; improve empty state messaging
goal: When an engagement has a completed discovery run with inventory snapshot containing hosts and services, the Surface Map canvas should visualize those hosts as nodes. If visualization is not feasible in this slice, at minimum improve the empty state: replace 'No inventory has been mapped yet' with context-aware messaging that explains WHY the map is empty and which run type populates it (e.g. 'Run a Passive Network Discovery scan to map your assets here'). The Asset Browser tabs should reflect available inventory counts from the snapshot.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: NFIR Live Acceptance engagement has a completed passive-web-baseline run with inventory snapshot. Surface Map canvas shows 'No inventory has been mapped yet'. Nmap results appear in Mission Control task list but not in the Surface Map visual. The Attack Path panel correctly shows 1 candidate path so some inventory IS present.
